title: Survey of Villages Abadi and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas (SVAMITVA)
summary: The scheme is a reformative step towards the establishment of clear ownership of property in rural inhabited (Abadi) areas, by mapping of land parcels using drone technology and providing Record of Rights to village household owners with the issuance of legal ownership cards (Property cards/Title deeds) to the property owners.

title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
summary: An Act to provide for the enhancement of livelihood security of the households in rural areas of the country by providing at least one hundred days of guaranteed wage employment in every financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
